notes.title: Game Content Update Announcement
notes.content:
Function modification:
The original skill replacement function has been removed. Now, you can freely switch between unlocked tasks within the skill bar
2. Excessive attack methods were removed, and two segments of light attacks and three segments of heavy attacks were retained
3. Duplicate guard side quests have been removed
4. The way to unlock the female lead has been modified. Now each female lead has an independent unlocking stage and task
5. Fixed the BUG of partial dialogue display
6. Fixed some achievement bugs that could not be achieved
7. More task descriptions have been added
8. Add shortcut keys for the backpack and skill interface


PS: This update will not affect the unlocked female lead of the old game.

notes.title: Game optimization update announcement
notes.content:
1. Remake part of CG animation
2. Fixed BUG that caused achievements to not trigger
3. Reduce the difficulty of the game and greatly reduce the affection required by the female protagonist
4. Fixed an issue where some players Tanya and Qingxuan could not trigger CG
5. Fixed the problem that functions such as female entrusted planting cannot be opened


Plus: New tour!! "Double male wind spread" - power intrigue and tenderness, interwoven legend!!
The game adopts two-line play, and the picture quality is comprehensively improved ！！！！ For details, please pay attention to the top of the group announcement!!
At present, steam has put on the store page, asking you to see the support of the official, move your hands, and click the wish list ~~
And please stay tuned. Thank you. Thank you ！！！！

notes.title: 2024年11月27日更新公告
notes.content:

1.增加圣法兰女主艾拉
2.移除减少陈杂的战斗功能

4.增加新动画两幅
5.一周内将会继续更新两位新女主及场景，请大家多多等待，再次抱歉！
